notes: Andrew, 2026-11-10: "I hate the lisabo, i have an agent working on trying to get it returned. YOu focus on an altnerative dining table from mybobs.com", "consider black friday" (Bob's "Black Friday Dining Rooms $799 and Under" page), "filter for length of table but also depth (i.e. note the problem of the Lisabo being too small depth wise at 26")", "Consider color as well". RANKED 2 of 3 on Bob's: the best value and the deepest top of the three, 2" over F-36's cap. On the Black Friday Dining Rooms $799 and Under page at $499.00 ("Bobs Bundled Price"; the product page calls it "Bob's Everyday Low Price"). Flags: tight:29 (F-36). Fit (dining-room, 98 x 89 between the two walkways, F-42): along the room's depth, 40" across leaves 29" a side, 1" under F-36's workable 30"; set 1" toward the kitchen, the wall side gets its 30" and the kitchen side 28" to the walkway's edge, its chairs pushing back into the walkway as F-36 allows that side. Closed, 60" long, it leaves 29" to the bottom wall (an end seat there is tight) and seats four on its sides; open with its 12" leaf, 72", it leaves 17" and seats three a side (F-36 checks it both ways). The set: the Bettie Walnut Extendable Dining Table (SKU 20079807007, $349.00 alone) and four Bettie Walnut & Gray Panel Back Upholstered Dining Chairs (SKU 20079807011, $110.00 each alone; both prices from the collection carousel): $789 apart. The 7-piece with six chairs (other-bobs-20081135) is $599.00, $100 more for two more chairs (F-60's "more later"). Chair colors on the page: Avocado, Gray, Multicolored, Russet, Teal; this record is the Gray. Color (F-68 (10)): walnut veneers on rubberwood solids and MDF, a mid-tone reddish walnut in the photos, lighter than the Mango but plainly dark on the white marble, and the walnut sibling of the living room's UGGLERUM (F-68 (2)); Gray seats match the MORABO's dark gray, Avocado is the nearest to the open plan's sage accent (F-68 (6)), and Russet is the orange F-68 (4) keeps out. Mid-century modern: flared tapered legs, button-tufted backs, Bob-O-Pedic memory foam seats. 2,116 reviews. Get it as soon as Nov 13 (to 11101); the 7-piece page offered free pickup at Bob's Piscataway, NJ distribution center and showed it in person at the Long Island City store. Returns (the page's Returns tab, 2026-11-10): an order cancels for a full refund until delivery or pickup day; after delivery Bob's takes furniture back only for factory defects, under a 1-year limited warranty. See it in person before ordering. No photo: Bob's images are on res.cloudinary.com/mybobs/, which catalog:image refuses until Andrew allows that folder.
